description: Exclusion and normalization produce the same result regardless of order for top-level exclusion sets: removing a null field by exclusion or by normalization yields identical canonical bytes. This vector does not distinguish which operation ran first — it confirms the combined outcome.
note: For top-level exclusion sets, exclusion and normalization commute: the order is unobservable in the output (removing 'id' by exclusion vs removing it because id=null are both equivalent). The digest equals jcs-n-kat-08: whether the excluded field is null or non-null does not matter; it is always stripped first.
